summary: Brøndbyernes IF Fodbold A/S operates the Brøndbyernes Idrætsforening football club in Denmark. The company also operates a football stadium with a capacity of 2, 80,778 spectators located in Brøndby. In addition, the company offers season tickets, TV agreements, partners, sponsors, food sales, events, rental of commercial property; and sales of merchandise and other retail sales. Brøndbyernes IF Fodbold A/S was founded in 1909 and is based in Brøndby, Denmark.
